interface: merlin.drafting_control.review_wiring(source, guide_dir, image, verdict_file, destination). Run each candidate once in a separate process. If a candidate has an opt-in validation mode, use the proposed publicly callable mode and record its exact settings. Preserve the raw decision, including warning/unknown values, and the status of output publication.
decision_policy: Positive=accepted only. Withhold=explicit review rejection, clarify/abstain/unknown preventing acceptance, or a specific validation refusal. A generic crash is a test failure. Accepted with an advisory warning counts as accepted.
promotion_gate: Keep both heldout positives accepted. Withhold both negative/ambiguous cases. Preserve development pass. Identical source and raster bytes for all arms. Local wall time descriptive.
